business_bounded.description: One stored launch face selects continuing valuation rate; independent scenario shocks can change value.

property_bounded.description: Property value including simplified reinvested operating performance; no additional rent credit.

stocks.description: One committed fair d6 per holding at each full owned lap; new current value only.

fund.description: Diversified market position; excludes a separate cash dividend.

bond.description: Simplified total-return bond position, not a promised bank deposit.

crypto.description: Speculative position; launch can fail; surviving position still fluctuates.

house_locked.description: Approved continuing launch rate on current value; separate deferred capped alternative is NOT applied.

fixed_contract.description: Use immutable life/annuity contract registry in central finance, never generic green growth.

timing.owned_clock: Monotonic owner board progress; first full owned-circuit return after acquisition for ordinary market positions.
timing.fixed_rate_clock: Accrue elapsed owned board progress using V*(1+r)^(elapsed/board_size); settle at lap/transfer/final boundaries.
timing.market_draw: Stored fair d6 once per position per full owned circuit; no terminal partial-circuit redraw.
timing.rounding: integer cents HALF_UP at each committed event
timing.launch: Commit funding then immutable fair d6 once. Closed failure value0 never rerolls or grows.

support_nonstacking: After cover, select one relevant service or mentor discount on residual eligible invoice; no duplicate reimbursement.

specific_eligibility.I2: Select owned vacant-property parent without this upgrade.
specific_eligibility.I3: Selected owned property must have completed I2 renovation; then becomes rental exposure.
specific_eligibility.RE_TRIPLEX: Own at least one active rental-property exposure.
specific_eligibility.RE_COMMERCIAL: Own at least one active direct multi-unit property of 2+ units; REIT holdings do not qualify.
specific_eligibility.RE_SHORT_TERM_RENTAL: Select one owned active rental-property parent; replaces long-term strategy, never duplicates the property.

deferred_expansions: L111–L113 equity migration; never duplicate approved luxury menu
new_recommendation_notice: Ordinary ongoing returns, service remapping, repeat controls, clock proration and upgrade accounting are recommendations. Youth House approved continuing rates remain intact. All fair draws are server stored; AI never calculates or chooses returns.
